title: HOW TO WIN MY HEART
lines: How to win my heart is a library of stacks.
It keeps 1,090 shots from 50 films. Every film is a tower, every shot a floor, every frame a window.
Its 7 streets are the scenes of the poem, in order: the first is “Walk from temple along harbor to cafe”.
The tallest tower is Apollo 12: Pinpoint for Science (1969): 36 floors.
Nothing in it is older than 1904 or newer than 2009.
The sign most often read here is dividual.
